output:
stories:
  - id: s1-daily-transfer-limit
    title: Refuse transfers over the daily limit
    asA: Portal customer
    iWant: transfers that would take me over my daily limit refused
    soThat: a stolen login can't drain my account in one day
    criteria:
      - given: an account with a limit of 1000 that has sent 900 today
        when: it asks to send 200
        then: the transfer is refused with LIMIT_EXCEEDED (HTTP 422) and nothing is posted
        trace: specs/transfer-limits/spec.md:6
      - given: an account with a limit of 1000 that has sent 900 today
        when: it asks to send 100
        then: the transfer is accepted
        trace: specs/transfer-limits/spec.md:10
    notes: ledger-api checks the limit in the transfer transaction against account.daily_limit. portal-bff still calls POST /transfers through gw-ledger-v1 and shows the refusal message from ux.md.
  - id: s2-remaining-limit
    title: Show how much of today's limit is left
    asA: Portal customer
    iWant: to see how much I can still send today
    soThat: I don't try a transfer that will be refused
    criteria:
      - given: an account with a limit of 1000 that has sent 900 today
        when: portal-bff calls GET /accounts/{id}/limit
        then: ledger-api returns limit 1000 and remaining 100, and the transfer screen shows "You can send 100.00 more today"
        trace: specs/transfer-limits/spec.md:17
      - given: an account ledger-api doesn't know
        when: portal-bff calls GET /accounts/{id}/limit
        then: ledger-api answers 404
  - id: s3-northwind-pay-velocity-checks
    title: Check unusual transfers with Northwind Pay
    asA: Portal customer
    iWant: unusual transfers checked with Northwind Pay's velocity check before the limit is applied
    soThat: a stolen login is caught even under my daily limit
    criteria:
      - given: a transfer ledger-api is about to accept
        when: ledger-api calls POST /v2/velocity-checks through gw-northwind-v2 with the hashed account reference and the amount
        then: the velocity check's answer is kept with the transfer before the limit is applied
      - given: a transfer with no account number or no amount
        when: ledger-api builds the velocity check request
        then: the transfer is refused, as mappings.md says
    notes: What happens when Northwind Pay flags a transfer or doesn't answer is still open; don't decide it in code.
  - id: s4-audit-events
    title: Send refused transfers to Audit
    asA: auditor
    iWant: every transfer refused for its limit recorded in Audit
    soThat: I can review limit refusals later
    criteria:
      - given: ledger-api refused a transfer with LIMIT_EXCEEDED
        when: portal-bff gets the refusal
        then: portal-bff sends a limit-refused event to audit-svc with POST /audit/events, with the account id as the subject
      - given: a refusal without an account id
        when: portal-bff builds the event
        then: no event is sent
  - id: s5-limit-change
    title: Record every change to an account's limit
    asA: support agent
    iWant: each change I make to an account's daily limit recorded
    soThat: every limit change can be traced to who made it and when
    criteria:
      - given: a support agent changes an account's daily limit from 1000 to 500
        when: ledger-api saves the new limit
        then: a row is written to limit_change with the account, the old and the new limit, who changed it and when
    notes: data.md names no migration for limit_change yet.
